title: ExampleNet: How a Request Becomes a Result
audience: Technically curious professionals encountering a personal AI assistant system for the first time
register: A five-minute editorial explainer: cinematic painted environments, precise structural diagrams, restrained typography, and visible causal transitions
references: Museum exhibition films: composed light and patient attention to physical detail
Technical cutaway illustrations: every connector explains a real dependency
Editorial title sequences: deliberate type scale and movement that carries meaning
mustNot: Decorative node networks that reveal no actual relationship
Generic clip-art icons or tiny centered elements in otherwise empty frames
Five minutes of static text cards over flat vector backgrounds
Motion or ornament that obscures the transition from request to verified result
